_comment: Mapping sidecar for generate-flow-diagram.py drift detection (#428). The diagram's node model is NOT 1:1 with the on-disk skill/agent inventory: some nodes are composite (one node covers several skills), some skills are rendered as a different node kind (data/gha) rather than a skill node, some skills are intentionally not drawn, and some skill-kind nodes are conceptual loop steps with no backing skill directory. This file makes those relationships explicit and deterministic so the drift check has zero false positives while still catching a genuinely new/renamed/removed skill or agent.

unmappedSkills.workflow-state: rendered as data node 'workflow-state.json' (id=state), not a skill node
unmappedSkills.definition-of-done: rendered as data node 'definition-of-done' (id=dod), not a skill node
unmappedSkills.archive-spec: rendered as GHA node 'archive-spec.yml' (id=gha_archive), not a skill node
unmappedSkills.promote-ready: operator-only tool; intentionally not drawn on the flow diagram
unmappedSkills.excalidraw: standalone diagram utility; intentionally not drawn on the flow diagram
unmappedSkills.lesson-prune: operator-only curation tool; intentionally not drawn on the flow diagram
unmappedSkills.create-workflow-schema: interactive scaffolding wizard; intentionally not drawn on the pipeline flow diagram
unmappedSkills.init: interactive onboarding wizard for new repository setup; intentionally not drawn on the pipeline flow diagram (prerequisite utility, not a pipeline step)
unmappedSkills.build-explore: standalone thinking-partner / read-only discovery tool; intentionally not drawn on the pipeline flow diagram
unmappedSkills.manage-stores: standalone operator utility for managing cross-repo stores[] in .claude/config.json; intentionally not drawn on the pipeline flow diagram
unmappedSkills.build-verify-spec: spec-level quality gate invoked as a sub-step inside po-agent Step 6 between build-verify and build-push-to-git; rendered as part of the build-verify flow node, not a separate node
unmappedSkills.quality-doc: operator-on-demand and post-merge scorecard generator invoked by documentation-agent Step 7.6; not a pipeline dispatch step, intentionally not drawn on the pipeline flow diagram (#598)
unmappedSkills.build-runtime-qa: runtime-QA gate invoked as a sub-step inside po-agent Step 6 #1b between build-verify-spec and build-push-to-git; rendered as part of the build-verify flow node, not a separate node

unmappedAgents.runtime-qa: dispatched by build-runtime-qa skill as an inner sub-agent; not a standalone diagram node (same pattern as coder, gate-scout, sensor-fixer which are also not drawn as separate nodes)

conceptualNodes.auto-seed: loop pre-poll pass, not a standalone skill directory
conceptualNodes.reconcile-orphaned: loop pre-poll pass, not a standalone skill directory
conceptualNodes.emit-reshape-request: orchestrate script step surfaced as a node, not a skill directory
conceptualNodes.CI poll & review: po-agent inner loop step surfaced as a node, not a skill directory
